workflow.name: AI Trading Alert Bot
workflow.description: Automates market data fetching, technical analysis, and AI-powered buy/sell signal generation. Monitors multiple cryptocurrencies and stocks, analyzes price trends, and delivers actionable trading alerts via Slack, Email, and SMS.

API_KEY.description: OpenAI-compatible API key for AI signal prediction

MODEL.description: Model name for AI signal prediction

workflow_steps.name: fetch_crypto_prices
workflow_steps.description: Fetch cryptocurrency prices from mock CoinGecko API

workflow_steps.name: fetch_stock_prices
workflow_steps.description: Fetch stock prices from mock Alpha Vantage API

workflow_steps.name: combine_market_data
workflow_steps.description: Combine crypto and stock data into a single list

workflow_steps.name: calculate_technical_indicators
workflow_steps.description: Calculate RSI, MACD, SMA, EMA, Bollinger Bands for each asset

workflow_steps.name: call_ai_signal_prediction
workflow_steps.description: Use LLM (gpt-5.1) to predict buy/sell/hold signal per asset

workflow_steps.name: generate_alert_message
workflow_steps.description: Generate formatted alert messages for Slack, Email, and SMS
